save_bytes_definition: UTF-8 compact json.dumps(Session.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False), with default JSON separators; excludes the SaveSlots envelope/timestamp and indent=2 expansion. Not a measured on-disk slot size.
load_seconds_definition: Time for json.loads plus Session.from_dict(version=31); file I/O is not part of this measurement.
elapsed_seconds_definition: Each checkpoint interval separately: new wait operations since the prior checkpoint, narration, serialization, reload, and equality checks. Not cumulative from zero.
narration_scope: Three fixture narrations at2000/5000/10000, not10000full model responses.
